# The record types

The view, the rules view and the commands carry these types as maps ([view.md](../view.md), [commands.md](../commands.md)). The package wraps them in records: one class per type, one property per field, as the generated module `opense4._records` defines them. A field that holds an id gives the object it names, and the id under the same name with `_id` ([python-api.md](../python-api.md), "The view"). `opense4.view.record(kind, data, view)` wraps a map of one of these types by hand.

The types that the public modules extend are on their pages: `opense4.rules.Component`, `opense4.rules.Facility`, `opense4.rules.Hull`, `opense4.rules.Rules`, `opense4.rules.Tech`, `opense4.view.Battle`, `opense4.view.Colony`, `opense4.view.Design`, `opense4.view.Empire`, `opense4.view.Fleet`, `opense4.view.Game`, `opense4.view.Location`, `opense4.view.Message`, `opense4.view.MyEmpire`, `opense4.view.Resources`, `opense4.view.SpaceObject`, `opense4.view.System`, `opense4.view.Vehicle`, `opense4.view.View`.

## `DesignSpec`

A design as create_design and edit_design take it. Only name, design_type, hull, entries, strategy and picture matter there; the engine sets the rest.

| Property | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `Optional[int]` | Its id (set by the engine). |
| `owner` | `Optional[Empire]` | Its owner (set by the engine). |
| `owner_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `owner`. |
| `name` | `str` | Its name, unique in the game. |
| `design_type` | `str` | One of my.design_types. |
| `hull` | `int` | The hull. |
| `entries` | `List[DesignEntry]` | The components, in order. |
| `strategy` | `int` | The combat strategy its vehicles use (a position in our strategies). |
| `obsolete` | `bool` | Obsolete. |
| `created_turn` | `int` | When it was made. |
| `template_name` | `str` | The computer designer's template it came from. |
| `retrofitted` | `bool` | A ship was refitted to it. |
| `ever_built` | `bool` | One was ever built. |
| `built` | `int` | Vehicles built. |
| `lost` | `int` | Vehicles lost. |
| `enemy_tonnage_destroyed` | `int` | Tonnage of enemies its vehicles destroyed. |
| `scrapped` | `int` | Vehicles scrapped. |
| `picture` | `str` | Its own picture: a base name looked up as a hull's bitmap names are (Mini_<picture>, Portrait_<picture>), in place of its hull's; empty for the hull's. At most 64 characters, no folders (packages-and-data.md). |

## `Queue`

A construction queue, with what each item costs and when it is done at the queue's rate now. The estimate assumes the treasury pays: an item takes ceil(what is left of each resource ÷ the rate) turns, at least one, once it is at the top; -1 means never at this rate (or the queue is on hold).

| Property | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `on_hold` | `bool` | Nothing is built. |
| `repeat` | `bool` | Finished items go on being built. |
| `emergency` | `bool` | Emergency building. |
| `emergency_turns` | `int` | Emergency turns used. |
| `slow_turns` | `int` | Slow turns left after an emergency. |
| `auto_waypoint` | `int` | The waypoint new vehicles go to; -1 none. |
| `rate` | `Resources` | What it can spend a turn. |
| `items` | `List[QueueEntry]` | The items, top first. |

The items, top first.

| Property | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `str` | What it builds. |
| `design` | `Optional[Design]` | The design (vehicles). |
| `design_id` | `Optional[int]` | The id of `design`. |
| `facility` | `int` | The facility, or an upgrade's target. |
| `count` | `int` | How many together. |
| `spent` | `Resources` | Paid so far. |
| `cost` | `Resources` | Its whole cost. |
| `remaining` | `Resources` | What is left to pay. |
| `turns` | `int` | Turns it takes once at the top; -1 never. |
| `done_in` | `int` | Turns until it is done, counting the items ahead; -1 never. |
